system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:54 UTC, sam.okafor successfully logged on to WS-LMARTINS-01 using a remote-interactive (Logon Type 10) session sourced from 203.0.113.250; a preceding Kerberos service-ticket request for that workstation also came from that address.
At 13:43:55 UTC, sysmaint was created by sam.okafor, and about one second later sysmaint was added to the domain Administrators group.

The 13:43:57 UTC task registered on WS-LMARTINS-01 under sam.okafor launches PowerShell with a hidden window and an encoded command. Decoding the command yields an expression that invokes a web request to http://203.0.113.250/a.ps1 and executes its result.
The RDP source address and the URL in the task command are the same, linking the remote logon to the suspicious download command.

The account’s administrator-group membership and the hidden PowerShell download-and-execute task are inconsistent with the stated help-desk practice of creating temporary non-administrator accounts; the activity is also inconsistent with the stated remote-administration restriction.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the activity; proxy requests during that period cannot be reviewed.
A Zeek connection from WS-LMARTINS-01 to the proxy on port 8080 is recorded at 14:06:13 UTC, but the supplied record contains no request URL or response details.
The task-registration record establishes the task definition, but the supplied evidence does not establish that the task ran or that the downloaded script executed successfully.
claims_not_established: Whether the task ran, whether the remote script was retrieved, or what that script contained or did.
Who controlled the source address 203.0.113.250 or whether sam.okafor's credentials or session were compromised.
Whether sysmaint was subsequently used, what access it obtained, or whether any data or systems were impacted.
Whether this account creation and task registration had any approved authorization not represented in the supplied evidence.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs or upstream web-gateway records for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including any request to 203.0.113.250/a.ps1 and the response.
Collect task execution history, PowerShell operational/script-block logs, and endpoint process and network telemetry around 13:43–14:00 UTC to determine whether the task and script ran.
Acquire and analyze the downloaded script or related endpoint artifacts, if present.
Verify with sam.okafor and the change/identity-management records whether the remote logon, sysmaint creation, administrator-group addition, and task were authorized.
Review subsequent authentication, group membership, and activity for sysmaint, and investigate the source address and any associated credential or session compromise.
